reason: V10 changed the conditional mean but reused a V8 Laplacian residual distribution centered on the old mean; V11 retrains the stochastic component around the frozen corrected mean and retains stochastic power at every non-DC mode
correction_selection: step 5000 was the predeclared terminal V10 correction and has the lowest TNG and SIMBA correction validation losses, both monotonically decreasing through step 5000
residual_target: truth - (frozen deterministic mean + frozen V10 correction), followed by exact per-cube DC projection
residual_frequency_support: all non-DC modes; no Laplacian or post-sampling spectral filter

model.initialization: all V8 EMA weights, with context standardization refit on corrected-mean TNG and SIMBA development training cubes

development_rule: select the smallest predeclared step passing all eight unchanged field checks on both TNG and SIMBA development ensembles with 16 objects, 16 members, and 40 EDM steps
postdevelopment_order: historical SIMBA CV0-15 stress field gate
sealed EAGLE confirmation32 field gate opened once
unchanged grid-HOP gate on TNG development, historical SIMBA, and EAGLE confirmation32

independence.independent_mean_correction: computed on the fly from observables and old deterministic mean only; no target is read to construct the corrected mean
independence.eagle_opening: only after both development domains and historical SIMBA stress pass
